# The Myth of the Lone Fashion Genius — finished platform kit

## 1. LONG
Follow one look backward from museum record to the absent production floor; distinguish creative authority from solitary manufacture.

## 2. SHORT 01
A rapid roll call of the decisions hidden inside “designed by.”

## 3. SHORT 02
Ask: if this person vanished from the record, what knowledge would the house lose?

## 4. CAROUSEL
Seven role plates with a decision, evidence field, and credit verb on each.

## 5. AUDIO
A six-question collaborator oral-history prompt with consent and correction language.

## 6. CLASSROOM
Map one object without inventing missing names; label the gaps as part of the evidence.

## Claim ledger
- **INFERENCE:** Fashion archives preserve evidence of many hands even when public storytelling centers one name. (S15, S16, S17)
- **PROPOSAL:** Credit and role records are institutional infrastructure, not ornamental acknowledgments. (S10, S15)

## Publication discipline
Do not add unlicensed imagery. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, and evidence labels. Legal analysis is issue-spotting, not legal advice.
